title: Finish reviewer claim lifecycle, audit trail and source-ref cleanup

checkpoint.summary: V2-06 completed. Reviewer release/reassignment preserves frozen Claimed revision independently of agent slots; immutable operation-id claim/release/reassignment/withdraw/decision evidence and reviewer recovery projection. Two-phase Git-ledger orphan cleanup reserves an exact source ref/SHA with permanent tombstone, then deletes by exact-OID lease only. Indexed review refs remain protected. Implementation commit d518ac5, experimental protocol 3.32.
checkpoint.nextAction: V2-06 accepted. V2-07 administrative lifecycle and V2-12 integration reconciliation are now dependency-ready. V2-09 spec APIs was previously unblocked. No production deployment, push, ledger initialization or V1 migration.
verified: Reviewer claim/release/reassign/withdraw/decide immutable events contain operation UUID, request version, actor, reason, pinned revision/ref/head and evidence
A released review stays Claimed awaiting orchestrator reassignment; owner cannot replace; reviewer occupancy change never frees a Working agent slot
Competing reviewers conflict by request CAS; disconnected/released reviewer loses decision authority; release works even if source ref disappeared
Orphan review inspection includes reserved matching, retargeted and absent states, with permanent ledger tombstone and source SHA
Two-phase reservation blocks delayed Submit/Update; source deletion requires expected SHA and rejects claimed, accepted and retargeted refs
Opted-in V2 client API tests exercise release, reassignment, audit, inspect, reserve, delete and post-deletion observation
Final Client.Tests 340/340 and Server.Tests 62/62 passed; prior quiet client run 339/340 had unidentified nonreproduced failure
